column1: # Duck Embody asset table — the roots that fetch_assets.sh mirrors.
# Columns:  key <TAB> s3_key <TAB> collision <TAB> variants
#   key        stable name used by apartment_layout.py / manifest.json
#   s3_key     object key under
#              https://omniverse-content-production.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/
#   collision  EXPECTED collision class, per design doc 03 §5:
#                native      collider ships in the USD (after `variants` below)
#                bbox_proxy  visual-only, needs an invisible cuboid proxy
#              This column is an EXPECTATION, not a fact: scripts/inspect_assets.py
#              measures the truth and the manifest records what it found. A
#              mismatch is a hard error there (doc 03 §7 — `collision_props` can
#              only MODIFY an existing collider, never add one, so a visual-only
#              asset declared "native" renders fine and the robot walks through).
#   variants   USD variant selections to apply, `set=value` comma-separated, or `-`.
#              The scene builder passes these to UsdFileCfg(variants=...) and
#              inspect_assets.py applies them before measuring, so the manifest
#              describes the asset AS SPAWNED.
# Catalog notes (all verified live 2026-07-26):
#   * SimReady props ship colliders behind a `PhysicsVariant` variant set whose
#     DEFAULT SELECTION IS `None`. Out of the box they have ZERO collision prims
#     and the robot walks straight through them. Selecting `RigidBody` yields
#     convexDecomposition colliders (armchair: 3 prims). The builder additionally
#     sets kinematic_enabled=True so furniture is solid but immovable — we want
#     obstacles, not a sofa that slides when a 42 cm duck leans on it.
#     (Design doc 03 §5 originally said "colliders INCLUDED" — corrected there.)
#   * SimReady props are authored in METRES (metersPerUnit = 1).
#   * ArchVis Residential is render-only: zero physics, no physics variant. Also
#     authored in CENTIMETRES (metersPerUnit = 0.01) — a naive scale=0.4 would
#     make them 100x too large. See manifest `scale_for_duck_scale`.
#   * Sektion_Cabinet's *_instanceable.usd already REFERENCES its
#     sektion_cabinet_collisions.usd (21 collision prims, purpose=guide), so the
#     collisions file arrives as a dependency and is not a root entry here.
# This is a deliberate SUPERSET of what the final layout uses: T2.1 picks the
# final furniture from measured AABBs, and re-fetching mid-layout-iteration would
# be a waste. Unused entries cost only disk (assets/ is gitignored).
# --- Isaac Props: kitchen counter run (the scored target anchor) --------------
sektion_cabinet
# --- SimReady props: colliders behind PhysicsVariant (see note above) ---------
armchair
crestwood_sofa
appleseed_coffeetable
bar_stool
dellwood_diningtable
dellwood_diningchair
# desk_01 is a SimReady CATALOG DEFECT: it carries the PhysicsVariant set on
# /RootNode but ships zero collision prims under EITHER option (verified by
# selecting each in turn). Unlike its siblings it therefore needs a bbox proxy.
# This is exactly the case doc 03 §7 warns about, and the reason the manifest
# measures collision instead of trusting the catalog's reputation.
desk_01
gardenplanter_medium
# --- ArchVis Residential: room-identity items SimReady lacks (visual only) -----
daybed
fridge
stove
microwave
plant_01
